teams.teamUpIntro: If you have an end-to-end neural network approach and have similar place, let’s join forces.

Solo dev with real infrastructure: ladder replay miner (1,000+ episodes), exact market-execution DP, fast self-play harness, leak analytics on top bots. Want 1-2 teammates strong in search/optimization or RL who measure everything and ship daily. Goal is top 10, not participation.

I’m looking for teammates to join me in this competition.
I’d love to collaborate on ideas, run experiments, and improve our solution together. My goal is to learn from each other while working toward a strong result.
All experience levels are welcome.
